cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a computer repair shop — opened desktop towers, a workbench with tiny screwdrivers, shelves of circuit boards and a magnifying lamp
cuts.scene: she is a technician sitting upright on a stool, resting her eyes a moment and thinking over the next repair
cuts.outfit: a computer technician look fitted to her body — a short sleeveless work vest over a fitted tank top and short shorts, bare shoulders and legs, a magnetic wristband
